description: Search public Discord servers indexed by disdex. Matches words against the server name, vanity URL, description, profile traits and guild tag. With a query, results are ranked by relevance (servers named for the query first, then matches in traits and descriptions, with bigger and more active servers first among similar matches); without one, by member count. Each result has its member and online counts, language, and a joinable invite link when one is known. If no server matches every word of a longer query, results match all but one word and partial_match is true. NSFW servers are never returned.

growing_within_days.description: Only servers whose member count was seen going up within this many days. A quick filter for active, growing communities.

language.description: Only servers whose name and description are in this language: an ISO 639-1 code such as en, es, de, pt, ru, ja.

query.description: Search words, at least 3 letters or digits (e.g. "minecraft survival", "study group"). Omit to browse everything by the chosen sort.

sort.description: Defaults to relevance with a query and members without one. members/online/boosts sort largest first; newest/oldest sort by when the server was created on Discord.

tag.description: Only servers with this Discord guild tag (the short tag members can show next to their name), case-insensitive exact match.

name: search_servers
title: Search Discord servers
